solution.title: IP/Port/URL Allow-List & Egress Filtering Management for Microsoft 365 & Intune Endpoints

products.name: IP/Port/URL Allow-List & Egress Filtering Management for Microsoft 365 & Intune Endpoints — Commercial
products.short_description: Administer the IP/Port/URL allow-lists and proxy/firewall exceptions that let Microsoft 365, Intune, Autopilot, and Defender endpoints work through tight egress filtering — built, validated, and kept current. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Make sure your filters let cloud management actually work

Tight egress filtering is required in regulated environments — but if the IP/Port/URL allow-lists miss a Microsoft 365, Intune, Autopilot, or Defender endpoint, enrollment stalls, policies never sync, and updates fail with no obvious cause. This solution gives you a repeatable way to administer network access controls for managed endpoints: build and maintain the required-endpoint allow-lists and proxy/firewall exceptions, validate reachability, and keep them current as Microsoft's endpoints change.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — why cloud-managed endpoints need specific egress access, the Microsoft required-endpoints model (M365, Intune, Autopilot, Defender, Entra), and the allow-list lifecycle.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a proxy/firewall you administer, the required-endpoints source, change control, a pilot scope, Entra/Intune reachability) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to derive the required IP/Port/URL set, build the allow-list / proxy exceptions, validate reachability on a pilot, then expand and keep it current as the endpoint list changes.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — required-endpoint + current-filter discovery, per-endpoint reachability validation, an allow-list coverage/gap report, safe allow-list update generation (preview first), and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (endpoint reachable, enrollment/sync/update succeed), plus Best Practices for change control and drift review.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Cloud management that works through strict egress filtering — the right IP/Port/URL allow-lists, validated and kept current — with a repeatable method and scripts you keep and reuse.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EGRESS-Discovery.ps1 — derive the current Microsoft required IP/Port/URL endpoint set and capture current filter state
    • EGRESS-Remediation.ps1 — generate allow-list update entries (and drift deltas) for import into the proxy/firewall
    • EGRESS-Report.ps1 — produce an allow-list coverage / gap report from the required set and validation results
    • EGRESS-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/populate the pilot Entra security group for staged allow-list rollout
    • EGRESS-Validation.ps1 — test per-endpoint reachability of the required IP/Port/URL set from behind the filter

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
